title: Coat Racks
body_html:
Versatile Hall Tree - This multitasker offers a bench to sit on while removing shoes, a shoe rack, hooks for clothing, and a shelf for keys and hats. Perfect for entryways, halls, bedrooms, or offices. 

3-in-1 Design - This bench coat stand marries storage and decor, boasting a coat rack, bench, shoe rack, and top shelf. Crafted with a black-finished metal frame, it keeps any room clutter-free.

Sturdy & Durable - The heavy-duty powder-coated metal frame and high-quality MDF board make this coat tree sturdy and lasting, capable of holding up to 250 lbs. It provides a convenient place to sit while putting on or taking off shoes.

Safe & Stable - The quality MDF board is waterproof, scratch-resistant and easy to clean. The entryway bench with hooks is safe for your family's health, featuring a water and rust-resistant powder-coated metal frame. Adjustable foot pads ensure stability and floor protection.
